sloka: प्लवंगमानाम् तु भय अर्दितानाम्श्रुत्वा वचः तार इदम् बभाषे ।अलम् विषादेन बिलम् प्रविश्यवसाम सर्वे यदि रोचते वः ॥४-५३-२५॥
transliteration: plavaṁgamānām tu bhaya arditānāmśrutvā vacaḥ tāra idam babhāṣe ।alam viṣādena bilam praviśyavasāma sarve yadi rocate vaḥ ॥4-53-25॥

translations.english: 'We should be killed since we have failed to achieve the objective (of finding Sita). There is no doubt about it. Who can live in peace without executing the orders of the king?
